 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 2 12-11-2024 1.
Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. This application, for grant of anticipatory bail, arises out of Bhagalpur Mahila PS case no. 26 of 2024, disclosing offences punishable under Sections 376, 504, 506, 379 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 67(A), 66(E) of I.T. Act.
3.

The prosecution story, as per the First Information Report, is that about 05 years ago, through mobile, petitioner started calling the informant regularly and during that period, the photographs of the informant was also shared on whatsapp, instagram, facebook etc., which was edited and the same was made obscene.
Informant's photo was forwarded by the Patna High Court CR. MISC.

No.71097 of 2024(2) dt.12-11-2024 petitioner on the mobile numbers of her family members.
Subsequently, the informant took admission in Mata Gujri Memorial GNM Nursing School,
Kishanganj (Bihar) in December, 2023, where also, the petitioner started forcing the informant to talk.

Admittedly, informant is a major aged about 19 years and petitioner is aged about 24 years.

5. Having regard to the submissions made on behalf of the parties and taking into consideration the fact that the relationship of petitioner and victim was considerably for a long period and the victim has not supported the factum of rape in Patna High Court CR.

7. Let petitioner, abovenamed, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Court below within six weeks, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st class,
